top_signals.title: CFOs Revamp Strategies in Face of AI
top_signals.summary:
Mozilla, known for its Firefox web browser and the Mozilla VPN, has set itself no lesser goal than to further the health of the internet. That mission is particularly relevant as artificial intelligence changes the way the internet works and how people use it. The software firm — which is a subsidiary of Mozilla.org, a nonprofit that promotes openness, innovation and participation on the internet — recently appointed a new chief executive to help revamp its strategy. Eric Muhlheim, who became CFO in 2021 after stints at Buzzfeed and Disney, talks about balancing mission and returns, diversifying Mozilla’s revenue streams and AI costs. Mozilla CFO Eric Muhlheim and Bloomberg's Nina Trentmann discuss the impact of AI on capex spend, corporate strategy, and company principles in our CFO Briefing. They speak with Bloomberg Businessweek Daily hosts Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec.

top_signals.summary: With Microsoft still searching for a winning AI strategy, the company its updating its Copilot app to combine more capabilities.

top_signals.title: Doubts grow over claims OpenAI agent hacked Australian Medicare portal
top_signals.summary: Researchers are questioning whether an OpenAI agent needed to hack an Australian government health portal to access it, after a review of the website’s archived code found it explicitly directed visitors to an unauthenticated endpoint.

top_signals.summary: A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the Elementor plugin for WordPress could allow an unauthenticated attacker to create administrator accounts. [...]
